description: This is the main Application class for the Nextcloud Notes Android client, responsible for initializing app-wide settings, preferences, theming, and integrations such as file type registry and debugging tools.

classes.name: NotesApplication
classes.description: Main application class handling initialization, theming, preferences, and file type registry setup for the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes preferences, theming, branding, debugging, and registers file app types when the application starts.

methods.name: registerFilesAppType
methods.description: Registers the file application type with the external registry if package ID and account type are available.

methods.name: brandingUtil
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of BrandingUtil.

methods.name: setAppTheme
methods.description: Sets the application's theme based on the provided DarkModeSetting.

methods.name: getAppTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme setting from shared preferences.

methods.name: isGridViewEnabled
methods.description: Checks if grid view is enabled based on shared preferences.

methods.name: updateGridViewEnabled
methods.description: Updates the grid view enabled setting.

methods.name: setLockedPreference
methods.description: Sets the preference for whether the app should be locked or not.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Determines if the app is currently locked based on preferences and last interaction time.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the application by setting the lock state to false.

methods.name: updateLastInteraction
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the last user interaction.
